snippets.text: fal says its H3 Max video model can now turn a Blender previs of up to 15 seconds into photoreal video, keeping camera movement and shot timing.
Elie Bakouch says DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and MiMo V3 both build their KV cache with YOCO, while Qwen 3.8 Next Flash and GLM 5.3 Flash interleave attention 3:1.
DigiTimes reports that TSMC plans to raise prices 3% to 6% in January 2027, with larger rises on advanced processes, according to Dan Nystedt.
Meta says Ray-Ban Display will show a photorealistic digital version of a caller's face on WhatsApp, driven by voice alone, in US early access this autumn.
Anthropic says health bodies including CEPI, WHO Africa and INRB Kinshasa are using Claude in their response to an unusual Ebola variant in the Congo.
Ollama says users can now buy usage credits for its paid cloud models without a subscription, and pay as they go.
Artificial Analysis says Claude Opus 5.5 at max effort in Claude Code scores 66 on its Coding Agent Index, the highest it has measured and 6 points above Opus 5.
Artificial Analysis puts inclusionAI's Ming-Image-0.1-Design, a 6B text-to-image model from Ant Group, first among open-weights models for UI/UX design and 17th overall in the category.
Mark Zuckerberg said Meta is building private processing for its glasses, so that when a wearer uses certain AI features nobody, including Meta, can reach their information.
TechCrunch says Meta's connector programme for its Muse agent drew more than 1,500 applications in under a week, with Stripe, Shopify, Walmart, Expedia, GitHub and Notion among the launch partners.
Simon Willison says he held a voice conversation with a Datasette backup of his blog through datasette-mcp, using the ChatGPT app on an iPhone.
The developer Theo says the root cause of the slow code highlighting in Claude turned out to be em dashes.
Arena.ai says Claude Opus 5.5 at max effort took first place in its Code Arena WebDev ranking with 1,818 points, 26 ahead of GPT-6 Astra.
Meta says owners of its AI glasses can now opt out of having visual data used for training, though the setting does not cover audio, Engadget reports.
StudentBench put AI tutoring level with expert human tutoring on GRE learning gains across 2,383 people, and its authors put the best AI tutor ahead in 5 of 7 subjects.
SWE-Flux asks models to reason about what code does when it runs, over 480 instances from 12 Python repositories. Its authors say the best model scored 37%.
A paper on memory for autoregressive video generation is on Hugging Face daily papers with 23 upvotes, and its authors have opened a reading list repository alongside it.
TestingCatalog says Mitra, a paid assistant from a team led by Sai Mandava, answers and places calls on a user's own number and is live on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Thomas Sottiaux of OpenAI says DevDay falls next Tuesday, calling the run-up the company's most ambitious sprint and crediting Astra for what it made possible.
Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 for audio wearables, claiming up to twice the on-device AI performance and up to 40% lower power draw.
Virtio-nvgpu, which forwards Nvidia driver commands from a KVM guest to the host, reached the Hacker News front page with 54 points and 20 comments.
HappyWorld-Bench tests 31 world models over 1,692 instances across video, spatial and embodied tracks. It has 22 upvotes on Hugging Face daily papers.
Zhejiang University's SpeakerMem-R1 proposes speaker-centred dual-track memory for multi-party dialogue, and sits on Hugging Face daily papers with 19 upvotes.
Tencent's RewardVerse says rubric-guided policy optimisation stops the scalar drift it attributes to single-score video reward models. It has 19 upvotes on Hugging Face daily papers.
